description: The out-of-character score of an agent's newest counted payment against its own earlier payments (behaviour.out_of_character.v2: amount out of its distribution, a new payee at a new size, a never-paid plain key, a probe then a large payment, a look-alike address, an approval change, off its rhythm), with the reasons that fired, how many of its last 30 days of payments scored notable or major, and the market's rates. Levels are none / notable / major; a level is a pattern for a human to read, never a verdict, and in shadow mode nothing is blocked from it. Every figure carries its measurement time and definition id.

agent.description: Agent token id, act_8453_N, slug or bound wallet

title: Is an agent's newest payment in character (free, shadow)
